description: This file defines a Dart class ('NewsApiClient') responsible for fetching news headlines from an external API ('newsapi.org') and handling associated exceptions through 'NewsApiException'. It also includes mock data in case of missing API key, and references external models ('NewsArticle').

classes.name: NewsApiException
classes.description: Custom exception class to handle API error responses with message and optional status code.

classes.name: NewsApiClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with the NewsAPI.org service, capable of fetching top headlines and providing mock data.

methods.name: fetchTopHeadlines
methods.description: Fetches top news headlines for a specified country and optional category from the external API or returns mock data if API key is missing.

methods.name: _mockArticles
methods.description: Provides mock news article data used in preview mode when real API access is unavailable.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the underlying HTTP client connection.
